page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor. It features 12 physical cores and 12 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, with 1 thread per core. The hardware configuration includes 24.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor, lacks local storage, and does not include any GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a moderate capability profile. The single-core performance is relatively low, with a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1107.38 and a weak single-threaded gzip compression rate of 19.09 GB/sec. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as shown by a stress-ng multi-core score of 8800.46 and a PassMark CPU score of 10233.84. Memory bandwidth is average, reaching 492.04 GB/sec for small cached blocks and approximately 59.6 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Database operations and Redis SET performance are also average, with Redis achieving 8.46 million operations per second.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance is designed for compute-focused workloads that do not require high memory density or local storage. It is suitable for multi-threaded processing, basic database operations, and lightweight web serving, though its weak single-core performance and lack of local storage present tradeoffs for single-threaded tasks and storage-heavy applications.
